title: Files matched by a wildcard include are applied in path order
rule: Refinement files matched by one wildcard include apply in lexical path order.

provisional.question: The documentation discourages wildcards with refinements and says their order cannot be controlled. Which order does Looker use?

citations.quote: But with refinements in particular, using wildcards in your includes is not recommended.
does not allow you to control the order in which each file is included
